$meta.description: A `smartAppliance` object can be obtained by using [include_lib](#GENERAL_INCLUDE_LIB). The `classID` used for this object is `"SmartAppliance"`.

model.description: Returns a `string` with the appliance model ID.
example: print("Model couldn't be determined due to: " + modelResult)

override_settings.description: Applies the exact power and temperature required by the appliance model. Other values return `"override_settings: invalid power or temperature for this model. Check the device manual."`. With the alarm enabled, returns `"override_settings: warning: Unsafe settings applied. The safety alarm will shut down the appliance if these values are reached."`; the accident is triggered only after the alarm is disabled, including by a later `set_alarm(0)` call.

set_alarm.description: Activates or deactivates the sound alarm indicating any appliance malfunction. If the operation is successful, a `number` with the value one is returned; otherwise, a `string` containing error details is returned. If the `enable` argument deviates from the defined signature, the method will return `null`. Disabling the alarm with `set_alarm(0)` can trigger an accident when unsafe override values are active.
example: print("Disabling alarm failed due to: " + setAlarmResult)
